plan.archetype: Efficient early attacks transitioning into poison and dexterity
plan.bossPrep: Build reliable damage, sustained poison, dexterity-backed block, and discard for Beckon. Preserve health; account for intangible turns and vulnerable attacks.
plan.summary: Take efficient damage first, then strengthen defense and poison scaling. Keep rewards selective and remove Strikes once damage improves. Fight elites with adequate damage and potions; heal when necessary.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity defense and selective discard
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy with established poison, reliable block, and Beckon discard. Defend vulnerable attacks; avoid wasting damage into intangible turns.
plan.summary: Heal at both remaining campfires and avoid elites. Prioritize dexterity, efficient block, poison scaling, and discard. Remove Strikes; upgrade Fumes when safe. Preserve potions for dangerous boss turns.

plan.bossPrep: Establish poison early, maintain weakness, and play Frantic Escape before sandpit expires. Block attacks independently; collect emergency potions. Upgrade Shadowmeld when health permits.
plan.summary: Poison acceleration and draw are the main deficits. Seek impactful damage rather than redundant support. Preserve eternal free Strikes, avoid elites, and heal now; upgrade Shadowmeld or Footwork when safe.
